description.text: There is an entry examination in late August.

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Yunnan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above

requirements.text: 1.No-criminal record. observe the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of YNU, Respect Chinese social customs and habits 2.Be in good health. 3.Applicants should be high school graduate or the equivalent. 4.Applicants have Chinese proficiency of HSK grade 4 or above.
